summary: Neo-Concept International Group Holdings Ltd filed a Form 6-K (the non-US equivalent of a US current report on Form 8-K) furnishing its first-half 2026 unaudited results for the six months ended June 30, 2026, signed by CEO and Chairman Pengfei Jiang. Revenue fell about 7.3% year over year to roughly HKD55.8 million (USD7.1 million), while SG&A rose about 40% to HKD33 million, driving a net loss of approximately HKD9.1 million (USD1.16 million) versus prior-year net income of HKD2.0 million; basic and diluted loss per share was HKD4.71. No transaction, board recommendation, advisor, or structural/regulatory terms are present, so there is no risk-arb angle.
